title: Parliament commits Data Protection Bill to Legislative Committee
why: Bill (Data Protection and Right to Access Information Bill 2026) passed second reading (draft stage).

title: Information Minister Tables Two Major Information Bills In Parliament
why: Bill tabled 5 Nov 2026; 2013 Right to Access Information Act currently governs (standing).

title: Cabinet Approves first ever Data Protection Policy, paving way for new data law
publisher: Ministry of Information and Civic Education
why: Cabinet approved new combined Data Protection and RTI Act and RAIC expansion.

title: RAIC Boss Describes 2024 as a Successful Year for Access to Information in Sierra Leone
why: Launch of the RAIC 2024 annual report (oversight body operating).

title: RAIC Presents 6th Annual Report to Minister Chernor Bah
publisher: Ministry of Information and Civic Education
why: Annual report presented; proactive disclosure by 79 public bodies (applied).

title: Ministry of Information Holds Pre-Legislative Session On Draft Data Protection And Right To Access Information Bill
publisher: Ministry of Information and Civic Education
why: Draft bill reviewed after nationwide consultations.

title: Press Freedom in Sierra Leone December 2024 – May 2025, Fourteenth Edition
why: RAIC reports 92 information requests Jan-May 2025; Act listed in force.

title: Annual Report 2023
why: Published figures: 19,496 requests recorded in 2023 and complaints resolved (applied).
